items.quote: This is an excellent repair shop. Price was fair, repair was completed as promised, and dont listen to the other reviews regarding communication and rudeness. The staff called me several times to let me know the status and they were very responsive.
I've been taking my cars to Flagler Auto Repair for years. They have always fixed my cars and I value their honesty and their excellent customer service.
They performed an amazingly quick diagnostic and effectuated prompt and complete repairs.
